Package dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockExperiments

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla.BedrockExperiments
public final class BedrockExperiments extends Object
The experiment toggles of Bedrock: the ids to give VanillaContent#experiments(String...) and what @BedrockExperiment names. Every toggle a captured Bedrock Dedicated Server had current is here; toggles retired before the oldest capture are not. @BedrockSince is the first bundled data version whose capture has the toggle (26.30 is the oldest, so it may be older), @BedrockUntil the first bundled release where it no longer does: Bedrock released or retired the experiment, and the toggle does nothing. @SincePreview marks a toggle only a bundled preview has.
Since:
1.0.0
